categories.help: Categories are the chips used to filter benefits. Create new categories and edit their name, color and order here.
categories.empty: There are no benefit categories yet.
categories.emptyHint: Categories group the benefit cards and let people filter them on the site. Create the first one to start adding benefits.
categories.nameEnHint: Optional. If you leave it empty, the English site shows the Spanish name.
categories.slugHint: Built from the name and can't be changed later. Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only.

slugErrors.format: Use 2 to 40 characters: lowercase letters without accents, numbers and single hyphens (for example, "mental-health").
slugErrors.taken: A category with that identifier already exists. Pick another one.

categories.deleteBody_one: The category “{{name}}” will be deleted along with its card. This can't be undone.
categories.deleteBody_other: The category “{{name}}” will be deleted along with its {{count}} cards. This can't be undone.
categories.deleteBodyUnknown: The category “{{name}}” will be deleted along with all its cards. This can't be undone.

corrections.intro: They apply on their own with 3 confirmations and more confirmations than rejections. Here you can apply one sooner or reject it (if it was applied, the SGA schedule comes back).

corrections.emptyHint: This is where schedules that students propose to fix from the Schedule Builder will show up. Normally you don't need to do anything: each correction applies on its own once enough other students confirm it.

hero.title: CEITBA
hero.subtitle: The voice and executive arm of students at the Instituto Tecnológico de Buenos Aires.
hero.description: We work to improve the university experience for every ITBA student, representing their interests, organizing activities, and building tools that make academic life easier.

benefits.title: Benefits designed for your time at ITBA
benefits.subtitle: Access to sports, exclusive discounts, events, academic support and student representation. Filter by category in the Benefits tab.

cta.title: Want to be part of it?
cta.body: Whether you'd like to join a team, pitch a project, or raise a topic that matters to you — get in touch. CEITBA is open to the whole ITBA community.

apps.sectionSubtitle: Platforms developed by the CEITBA IT team for the student community.

scheduler.label: Schedule Builder
scheduler.description: Generate all possible schedule combinations for your courses and find the perfect arrangement for your semester.

newsletter.label: ITBA Newsletter
newsletter.description: Stay up to date with everything happening at ITBA: events, academic news, job opportunities and CEITBA activities.

apuntes.label: Notes
apuntes.description: Notes, summaries and past exams other students share from their Google Drive, organized by subject.

departments.sectionSubtitle: The teams that keep CEITBA running.

it.name: IT
it.description: Develops and maintains CEITBA's digital platforms: schedule builder, newsletter, institutional website, and more.

media.name: Media
media.description: Manages institutional communication, social media, and audiovisual content production for CEITBA.

infraestructura.name: Infrastructure & Projects
infraestructura.description: Manages and improves physical spaces, equipment, and infrastructure initiatives of the student center.

nautica.name: Nautics
nautica.description: Organizes nautical activities, regattas, and water sports programs for the ITBA community.

deportes.name: Sports
deportes.description: Coordinates inter-major leagues, tournaments, sports activities, and access to facilities for all students.

directivos.name: Board
directivos.description: CEITBA leadership, student representation before university authorities, and strategic management.

benefits.sectionSubtitle: What CEITBA offers its members and the entire student community.

deportes.name: Sports
deportes.description: Access to soccer, basketball, volleyball fields and other sports facilities. Leagues, tournaments, and recreational activities throughout the year.

membresias.name: Memberships & Discounts
membresias.description: Exclusive discounts at restaurants, bookstores, gyms, digital platforms, and brands associated with CEITBA.

eventos.name: Events & Culture
eventos.description: Talks with industry leaders, workshops, cultural activities, shows, and social events organized throughout the year.

academico.name: Academic Support
academico.description: Collaborative notes, study groups, and academic resources shared among students from all degree programs.

representacion.name: Student Representation
representacion.description: Active voice and participation in decisions affecting ITBA students, with presence in governance bodies.
